items.title: HSBC CEO warns the AI boom won’t make every data center a good bet
items.summary: AI is a transformational technology worth investing in — but investors must be selective when investing in data centers, according to the head of one of the world's biggest banks.

items.title: The world’s finance chiefs see new risks — and less China angst
items.summary: The world's finance chiefs spent last week in Bangkok debating the biggest risk facing the global economy — with debt, artificial intelligence and trade imbalances topping the list.

items.title: UK inflation jumps to 3.5% — cementing rate hike expectations
items.summary: U.K. inflation rose by a hotter-than-expected 3.5% in the 12 months to September, driven by the surging cost of motor fuels.

items.title: Car buyers are demanding lower prices and better tech. Automakers must deliver both
items.summary: Global automakers face an increasingly demanding customer: one who wants both competitive prices and better technology, according to Bain & Company.

items.title: Housing is flashing warning signs just as the Fed weighs more interest rate hikes
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's inflation fight is running into a growing complication: The housing market is slumping even as broader price pressures persist.
